errors.text_span: Най-високата стълба, представляваща „Общ публичен“, достига височина 28.6%
errors.evidence: This statement has two errors. First, the longest bar is for "Обратен насип" (11 responses, 52.4%), not "Общ пълнител". Second, the category name is misspelled as "Общ публичен" instead of "Общ пълнител".
The value for the category "Обратен насип" is 11 responses, which corresponds to 52.4% according to the chart, not 52.8%.
The value for the category "Фирмите изпълнители са зад..." is 1 (4.8%), not 5 (23.8%). The value 5 (23.8%) corresponds to the category "В пътното строителство".

errors.evidence: This is an interpretation of the data, which is explicitly forbidden by the prompt. The description should only state what is visually present.
